name: SonicTheHedgehog2Recomp
summary: Native Sonic the Hedgehog 2 recompilation with a player-prepared Windows runtime.

source_requirements.label: Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (World) Rev A raw big-endian Genesis original

presentation.manual_preparation: Extract the exact official v0.8.3 Windows ZIP outside the Portcove library. Place a byte-identical copy of the exact original in the package root as game.bin and register game.bin separately; it remains immutable and is passed directly with --no-launcher. Use only the exact World Rev A original. Optional party settings and nine fixed local-state slots are preserved, without operation acceptance. Campaign stores, configurable destinations and PID-named temporary files are outside this route; do not enable campaign modifications. Keep debug.ini and legacy interp_fallbacks.log absent; unknown files refuse verification before launch. Preserve all package licenses and notices. PolyForm Noncommercial terms do not establish ROM rights or redistribution permission. Use short Windows-code-page representable paths. Settings/saves remain player-owned. Updates are user-managed; no acquisition, managed maintenance, backup or external deletion is offered. Sequential checks do not sandbox the runtime or disable inherited developer opt-ins. Windows consent-bound registration, revalidation, two Core-mediated startup/ordinary-close/restart cycles, immutable/original checks and registration-only removal were observed with the recorded qualification CLI/private catalog and named developer opt-ins cleared in the child environment. Gameplay, in-game save/load, optional features, controller/audio/visual correctness and other platforms remain unqualified.

steps.title: Extract the port
steps.instruction: Extract the exact official v0.8.3 Windows ZIP outside your Portcove library. Keep all package licenses and notices.

steps.title: Make a working copy of the original
steps.instruction: Copy the exact World Rev A original into the package root as game.bin, without changing its bytes.

steps.title: Connect and review
steps.instruction: Choose and check that same game.bin in Portcove, then choose the extracted port folder below. Portcove launches with the upstream launcher skipped.

warnings: Keep debug.ini and interp_fallbacks.log absent. Do not enable campaign modifications or configurable save destinations; this route covers only fixed local outputs.
Use short Windows-code-page representable paths and ordinary runtime defaults. Optional features and gameplay remain unqualified; inherited developer options are not sandboxed.
